title: Philadelphia Museums self-guided walking tour & scavenger hunt
includes: Scavenger Hunt with 36 challenges to solve
See 8 film locations from your favorite movies or TV series.
38 locations with outstanding sights and history
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller

Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Are you visiting Philadelphia? You must try our scavenger hunt through the Philadelphia Museum district to see all the sights! It will take you from City Hall to the Philadelphia Museum of Art all while taking a few side trips and proposing challenges at every leg. All the while, you will learn some local history and get valuable local tips.
Buy either a single or a group ticket.
This 3-hour self-guided walking tour is completed with your smartphone. You can start it at your leisure, on any day or time. You can also go as fast or as slow as you wish. Pause at any time and resume when ready.
